name: Corpay, Inc
moat_justification: Moderate moat: embedded AP-automation/fleet/lodging workflows with ~93% retention and card-acceptance network scale give real switching costs, but enterprise mix shift is compressing revenue per spend dollar (0.70% to 0.58% in Corporate Payments), fintech and bank/network rivals contest every segment, vehicle payments face a long-run EV headwind, and leverage plus the FTC settlement show pricing/regulatory limits.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 2.6%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.8x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 6.8x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: Quality B2B payments compounder, moat 6/10, with a real buyback tailwind — but at $393.02 the weighted IRR is 13.5%, below the 15% hurdle; clears 15% at ~$337, and with a margin of safety for 6.8x net-debt/OE nearer $285-305.
moat_for: Embedded AP/fleet/lodging workflows — high switching costs, ~93% retention
Fleet acceptance network and cross-border platform scale
Cross-sell across three segments on one platform
OE positive 5/5 of last 5 years; 5y revenue CAGR 13.6%
moat_against: Yield compression: Corporate Payments revenue per spend dollar 0.70% -> 0.58% on enterprise mix
Fintech AP/expense rivals plus banks and card networks selling direct
Vehicle payments tied to fuel volumes — long-run EV transition headwind
Regulatory overhang: $100M preliminary FTC settlement charge in Q2 2026
Leverage: net debt 6.8x normalized OE funds part of the buyback
